import sys
import time
import M5
from unit import PIRUnit
assert '/m5-live-2ecdf1692dbb463bad553b31ad673a66' in sys.path, "MicroPython VM was reset"
M5.begin()
screen = M5.Display
screen.setBrightness(255)
screen.fillScreen(8978312)
screen.setTextSize(2)
screen.setTextColor(0, 8978312)
# The frozen custom port is white=GPIO1, yellow=GPIO2. PIR signal is white.
pir = PIRUnit((1, 2))
print("LIVE_B_READY")
previous = None
while True:
 M5.update()
 value = int(pir.get_status())
 if value != previous:
  print("LIVE_B_PIR", value)
  screen.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 80, 8978312)
  screen.setCursor(4, 4)
  screen.print("RUN B")
  screen.setCursor(4, 32)
  screen.print("PIR " + str(value))
  previous = value
 time.sleep_ms(25)
